description.value: C4U Cafe is a locally owned coffee shop whose Downtown Vancouver location sits at 955 Burrard Street, adjacent to the YMCA. The cafe serves freshly prepared meals, sandwiches, pastries, smoothies, and coffee with a wide menu spanning vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options. It also provides event catering and offers complimentary Wi-Fi, making it a functional stop for cyclists passing through the downtown core.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming the Downtown location at 955 Burrard St with phone (604) 428-1620, matching OSM exactly. The FAQ explicitly confirms complimentary Wi-Fi, takeout/delivery services, and vegan/vegetarian/GF menu options, all corroborated by OSM diet tags and multiple website passages. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: C4U Cafe has a second location at 2775 Laurel St, Vancouver (Fairview), phone (604) 876-0089; that location is not represented in this OSM record and may warrant its own separate listing.

A customer review references 'YMCA is a community center,' suggesting the cafe may be located inside or attached to a YMCA facility; worth confirming whether walk-in public access is available without a YMCA membership.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe with a live website, confirmed address and phone, and a broad food and beverage menu — clearly useful to touring cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms: 'We offer a variety of vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options on our menu.' Catering page adds: 'Dairy-free and vegan options are available.'. Menu lists a dedicated 'Rice & Black Beans Vegan Bowl'
